stance_rationale: Alpha graduation gates fail simultaneously: rank_IC 0.0153, ICIR 0.1533, Harvey-NW t 2.1574, DSR 1.2808e-60, subperiod stability 0.1281. The emitted alpha_scores.parquet is a single 2026-04-30 snapshot, so the package violates RF-A7 and cannot support walk-forward QEPM validation.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Package signal_matrix_ref points to stage_artifacts/WT-D20260508_009/alpha_scores.parquet, which has 2002 rows but only one Date. User-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_009 path is absent.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: run_alpha_research.R uses Z_Score_Aligned from load_month_factors(); grep found no NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN.
factor_db_connector::align_factor_direction filters IC history by Usable_Date <= sig_date.
Factor loading route is load_month_factors(); no direct factor_db parquet read found in the alpha script.
No regime overlay is used in alpha scoring; same-month BM regime appears only in ex-post AX-001 diagnostic.
Fundamental lag is inherited from Factor DB and package lag rules state quarterly 45d / annual May.

critical_concerns.description: Core alpha diagnostics miss every graduation threshold: rank_IC 0.0153 < 0.04, ICIR 0.1533 < 0.20, Harvey t 2.1574 < 3.0, DSR 1.2808e-60 < 0.50, and sub_stability 0.1281 < 0.50. This is not deployable alpha evidence under RF-A1/RF-A6 and AX-002.

alpha_scores.parquet is a single-date forward snapshot, not Date x Ticker x score time series. This recreates the Iter 4 failure mode and invalidates walk-forward alpha/weights validation under RF-A7 and PIT-C1 process discipline.

Composite ICIR 0.1533 is far below Q07 standalone ICIR 0.6689 and QMA ICIR 0.5236; BAB sleeve is negative at IC -0.0026. The added BAB sleeve dilutes rather than contributes, so RF-A2 is triggered and AX-005 EXCLUSION is treated as sufficient when it is only necessary.

The emitted forward top-20 names all have n_sleeve_cov=2 and missing Q07, while only 593/2002 names have all three sleeves. The claimed BAB+Q07+QMA multi-sleeve EXCLUSION is therefore not actually enforced in the deployable alpha vector, weakening AX-005/AX-007 compliance.

Universe labeling is inconsistent with the hard mandate: package says KOSPI200_KOSDAQ150_intersection, but alpha_scores contains 2002 liquid names, far beyond KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150. This creates an AX-002 harness-validity gap before optimizer handoff.

No challenge_note.md or artifact_lineage.json exists; INFO-level challenge_flags inside alpha_package_draft are not a substitute for Charter No Silent Override evidence. AX-008 triangulation also cannot pass because risk/optimization packages and challenge notes are absent.

Required weights.csv and covariance.parquet are absent at the requested paths, so schedule validation, PSD, and condition-number checks cannot be verified. This blocks end-to-end QEPM evidence under AX-002 and RF-A7.

supporting_arguments: Top-decile liquidity passed the 2e8 KRW ADV20 floor in the available alpha_scores file.
C13/C14/C15 appear structurally compliant through load_month_factors() and Z_Score_Aligned.
Composite decile monotonicity is directionally positive with Spearman 0.8909, but this does not offset failed IC, DSR, subperiod, and time-series gates.
unresolved_disputes: Exact requested stage dirs qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_009 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260508_009 are missing; only stage_artifacts/WT-D20260508_009 exists.
No alpha_package.json, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, or *_challenge_note files were present for 3-agent comparison.
Direct correlation versus Hybrid 70/15/15 was not computed; the package substitutes an orthogonality proxy after saying direct reproduction was not feasible.
weights.csv and covariance.parquet are missing, so schedule and covariance verification cannot be completed.
weakest_assumption: The fragile claim is that AX-005/AX-007 multi-sleeve EXCLUSION rescues BAB, despite failed composite gates, negative BAB sleeve IC, and an emitted top-20 alpha vector that does not contain all claimed sleeves.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate alpha_scores.parquet as multi-date Date x Ticker x score with at least 60 monthly sig_dates and no single-snapshot handoff.
Show composite ICIR and Harvey-NW t exceed the best single sleeve after multi-testing, or remove the dilutive BAB sleeve.
Enforce full multi-sleeve coverage for candidate and top-ranked names, or prove partial-sleeve names do not dominate optimized holdings.
Provide challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json with RF-A1-A7 responses and write_json to record_lineage ordering.
Provide weights.csv and covariance.parquet or explicitly scope this as alpha-only with optimizer/risk verification blocked.
rationalization_red_flags: Direct Hybrid 70/15/15 alpha-vector reproduction not feasible at agent runtime
Inter-sleeve cor + size/momentum cor sufficient signal-level orthogonality proxy
AX-005 v1.2 EXCLUSION: multi-axis quality composite + multi-sleeve PASS path

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The package self-reports eligible=false and fails core diagnostics, yet still frames several structural checks as PASS. External critique should require regenerated time-series alpha and composite-value proof before any optimizer or risk handoff.
